name: Info and Relationships
description: Proper heading hierarchy (H1 -> H2 -> H3) and semantic tags.

name: Contrast (Minimum)
description: Text should have a color contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

name: Keyboard
description: All interactive elements should be keyboard accessible (buttons, links, forms).

name: Language of Parts
description: Avoid excessive jargon and keep sentences simple.

name: Labels or Instructions
description: Form inputs must have associated labels.
